notes.title: 40k Players and a Roadmap
notes.notes: [p]Hey all,[/p][p align="start"]It's been 2 weeks since the last update and I feel compelled to start by saying an [i]enormous[/i] thank you to the [b]more than 40,000[/b] players of the demo so far across all platforms. [b]FORTY-THOUSAND[/b].  Honestly, that number just boggles my mind and leaves me almost lost for words, so just, [i][u]thank you[/u].[/i]  [/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]An extra-special thanks also those who have been providing feedback via the in-game links, comments on Itch or on Steam - due to all of this I've been able to prioritise some key changes and I'd like to get these all wrapped up before the next demo update. So while it might be a couple of weeks before I have new builds to publish, rather than just dissapearing into the ether I thought it might be a good idea to share the roadmap for what I hope to be working on in the coming months.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]The game isn't [i]too [/i]far from v1.0, although as always polish, bugs and finalising builds can take way more time than expected so I've left a considerable runway for these once I have the game relatively feature complete.  Also, I just want to add a quick note that I'm working on [b]CoP only [/b]in my spare time, so as much as I'd love to create the ultimate-pinball-behemoth-of-a-game, I have to be realistic about what I can do in a reasonable time without burning out.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]With all that said, on with the plan:[/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b][u]Septermber 2025[/u][/b][/p][list][*][p]Ball Rituals: I really want each ball to have more flavour beyond the initial starting bonus, so I've been working on unique rituals for each ball that plays off it's key strength. [/p][/*][*][p]Gylph balance pass and icon update - I've been wrestling with the visuals for the Glyphs for far too long, so I'm moving to a more pictorial representation of what each one does. I'm still not 100% happy with it so far but it's better than it was, and will revisit later in the roadmap.[/p][/*][*][p]Graphics settings menu - by far the most-requested feature and one I should have had in long before now - this will let you customise your video/graphics preferences to allow for various quality settings and screen resolutions.[/p][/*][*][p]Linux and MacOS versions of the demo for both Itch and Steam[/p][/*][*][p]Glyph Infusions - both the visuals and the balance of these are long overdue a pass[/p][/*][*][p]Mid-run saving - at the moment saving/loading haldway through table is a sure-fire way for things to go wrong, this will get fixed. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145033/c4e8da9ce408ee3ee28e3c33161ed6b643134059.gif"][/img][/p][p][i](WIP - The ritual for the Cheater ball deals damage depending on how many Spare Balls you have)[/i][/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b][u]October 2025[/u][/b][/p][list][*][p]Proper localisation as well as font support for Chinese, Japanese, Korean and Cyrillic-langauges[/p][/*][*][p]Bonus Table rework - Bonus Tables will be changed to include one large centre bumper that requires hitting several times to break. Upon doing so, the player will gain an extra Blessing. Also, the bonus table for the demo needs a serious visual update, I cringe whenever it loads.[/p][/*][*][p]A thorough balance pass of blessings, curses, balls, rituals, blockers and bumpers[/p][/*][*][p] Balls 7 and 8 - 6 balls are now feature complete and ready to go, the plan for these last two are a bit more complex so I've been putting it off because reasons. [/p][/*][*][p]Table 4 finished. Tables 1, 2 and 3 are all pretty much done, with the exception of a visual pass for 2 and 3. Table 4 still needs refined before I lock down the design and start working on the backboard art.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b][u]November 2025[/u][/b][/p][list][*][p]HUD pass - I want to make sure all the information displayed is done so effectively, there's currently a bit of confusion for some new players so I'm hoping to add some features that make it more obvious what's happening, even when [i]everything[/i] is happening[/p][/*][*][p]Audio Pass - I've had some insanely good feedback on audio from a couple of really talented, clever audio folks so I'd be insane not to implement as much of that as possible. Plus, a lot of events in the game still don't have basic audio hooked up, or they reuse previous audio SFX, and it's starting to grate on me.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b][u]December 2025[/u][/b][/p][list][*][p]Steam achievements[/p][/*][*][p]First Submission Builds for all platforms (more on this in a future post....)[/p][/*][*][p]Balance pass[/p][/*][*][p]Beta tests[/p][/*][*][p]Bug fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Press and Content creator outreach (even now, please [url="mailto:kenny.makes.games@gmail.com"]get in touch[/url] if this is you!)[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b][u]Q1 2026[/u][/b][/p][list][*][p]Bugs, Polish, Marketing and...[/p][/*][*][p][b][i][u]!!! LAUNCH !!! [/u][/i][/b][/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]I'm hoping to be able to confirm the launch date within the nextcouple of months, depending on a few factors but as you can see I'm planning on giving myself plenty of leeway for things taking longer than expected, new features that just absolutely have to be added when I hear them, or just generally time that I can walk away from CoP for a week or two if it just stops being fun to work on. [/p][p align="start"]Anyway, I hope this is of interest to some folk, as always please let me know any thoughts and suggestions - I revisit the comments and feedback regularly so there might be some more changes coming that aren't mentioned in this roadmap, as I'm still testing out some of the suggestions made.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Happy Flipping![/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Kenny[/p]

notes.title: Demo Update v0.8.109

notes.title: Massive Update: Blessings, Sparks, Burn and more
notes.notes: [p]It has been a crazy week due to being a part the [b]Tiny Teams 2025[/b] Steam festival alongside a huge uptick in players on Itch.io, so first a massive thank you to everyone who has checked the game out so far! And now I'm happy to announce [b]v0.8.87 [/b]of the demo with a whole bunch of fixes and changes but one core new feature I've been working on for a while:[/p][p][b]Blessings! [/b]Blessings are a huge bonus you can select [b]at the end of every Act! [/b]There are 12 to choose from in the demo so far but there will be 32 in the final game, and I'll update the demo to 24 once they've been playtested a bit more. Obviously, this has massively changed the game balance to the point where it might now be a bit [i]too[/i] easy on lower difficulties, but I'll see how it feels for a while before tweaking anything to compensate. Some of these were previously purchasable Glyphs, which I've not removed and replaced with new ones so there are still 40 to unlock in the demo.[/p][p]Currently, the [b]Blessings [/b]you can choose from are:[/p][list][*][p]Reduce the mission count for a specific ritual by 2 (4 Blessings, one for each [i]Multiball[/i], [i]Tempest[/i], [i]Inferno[/i] and [i]Sparks[/i])[/p][/*][*][p]Chain lightning effect between all active balls[/p][/*][*][p]Double Blocker HP[/p][/*][*][p]Increase Mana reward at the end of each Act[/p][/*][*][p]Rerolls in the shop start at 0[/p][/*][*][p]Reduce Glyph prices by 50%[/p][/*][*][p]Increase maximum Glyph count by 2[/p][/*][*][p]Duplicate Glyphs now appear in the shop (good for very specific builds)[/p][/*][/list][p]Additionally, I felt the [i]Sparks [/i]Ritual was a bit underwhelming, and often found it was hard to reach that one last bumper in a stage so I reworked it into dealing high damage to the nearest bumper of each actie ball, which has made it feel much, much more fun to play and when combined with [i]Multiball[/i], absolutely shreds bumpers. Also in this patch is the addition of a [b]Burning[/b] mechanic, triggered by the [i]Inferno [/i]Ritual and the [i]Pyro [/i]ball, where targets take additional damage over time. Overall, much more destruction to be had. [/p][p]Here's the full patch notes for v0.8.87:[/p][list][*][p][b]Blessings [/b]system added[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sparks Ritual [/b]reworked to be much more effective (and fun)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Burning [/b]feature for [i]Inferno [/i]and [i]Pyro[/i] ball, dealing damage over time[/p][/*][*][p]All [b]Blocker Reset Glyphs[/b] no longer take up a Glyph slot (they're just destroyed on use)[/p][/*][*][p]All [b]Blocker Reset Glyphs [/b]now display the blocker HP as a % in the description[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cheater Ball [/b]now grants a spare ball [i]at the end of every Act[/i]. Survivability maxed out.[/p][/*][*][p]Some Glyphs added, others removed. Play to see the full changes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Boss Bumper HP [/b]is now shown at the top of the screen when it's active[/p][/*][*][p]Performance imporvements throughout[/p][/*][*][p]Minor bug and text fixes[/p][/*][/list][p]Overall, I feel this is a definitive shift in the game and one I hope makes it altogether a much more enjoyaable experience. While the Demo is still capped at 6 Acts, the full game will have an [b]Endless mode -[/b] last night I managed to get my fist e-number damage alongside a [i]Sparks[/i] and [i]Multiball[/i] combo and it just felt [i]insane[/i]. I hope everyone else will enjoy it as much as I do![/p][p]Happy Flipping![/p][p]Kenny[/p]

notes.title: Cult Of PiN & the Tiny Teams Festival!
notes.notes: [p]I am very, very excited to announce that [b]Cult Of PiN[/b] has been selected for the [i]Tiny Teams 2025[/i] Steam festival! Brought to you by the folks over at Yogscast, being chosen for this is a huge honour and hopefully, gets the game seen by more players and helps spread the word. If all goes well, streamers will be showcasing some as-yet-unreleased footage of the Beta version of the game, which I've been hammering away at in recent weeks to get it to an appropriate standard. The festival will run for a week starting on the 7th August, so keep your eyes peeled! [/p][p][/p][p]To celebrate, I've updated the Steam Demo of CoP to [b]v0.8.55[/b], which includes a huge number of bug fixes, balance changes, visual tweaks and all the juiciness I could squeeze out of what I have so far. There is still a long way to go, but overall it's starting to take shape into something close to what I hope the final game will be like. [/p][p][/p][p]If you have the time, please download the latest demo, give it a shot and let me know what you think - all the feedback I've received so far has been crucial in getting to where I am now, so thank you and keep it coming![/p][p][/p][p]Happy Flipping,[/p][p]Kenny[/p]

notes.title: Demo Hotfix Patch (v0.8.39)
notes.notes: [p]So, it turns out I'd left a development save file in the previous builds, that meant the game skipped the tutorial and had a handful of glyphs already unlocked. This meant no explaination of all the weird mechanics, so kudos to those that played without it and somehow still grasped what the heck was going on, and big thanks to the users who reported the issue.[/p][p]I've patched this now with an updated save mechanic that will also allow for saves to persist between versions. While saves [i]will [/i]be reset when the game goes into full launch, this will at least mean not having to unlock everything multiple times from now on. There are also a couple of minor fixes for missions triggering, but beyond that, this is just a patch to fix the saves.[/p][p]Apologies to anyone who has played the recent builds, please go check out the new build as it should hopefully make it a whole lot less confusing... I hope.[/p][p]Happy flipping![/p][p]Kenny[/p]

notes.title: A new Demo and an enormous overhaul
notes.notes:
[h1]PiN Update: Visuals & Physics Overhaul[/h1]

It's been a while since I last posted or updated, but hopefully the new screenshots should make it fairly obvious. I've spent the last couple of months giving the game a massive visual overhaul! Alongside the new look, there have been a ton of significant gameplay changes, which meant a stack of work just to get the demo playable again, one of the biggesting being that I've rebuilt the physics from the ground up, resulting in what I hope to be a much more realistic pinball simulation and making the game a good bit more challenging. And, good news, the demo is available once again!

With the new physics, I've also rebalanced bumper and blocker hit points, revisited and reworked the table traits (now called Curses), and added a new feature: chaining certain missions together now triggers one of four special effects.

[h2]Changelist (Not everything, but the highlights)[/h2]
[list]
[*]A whole new visual style: Creepy, dark, hand-drawn cartoon cult-vibes.
[*]Physics rebuilt: Hopefully this is a more accurate pinball experience.
[*]New Feature: Specials, including:
[*]Tempest: Rain down destruction from above for 10 seconds.
[*]Inferno: All active balls burst into flames, dealing area damage for 20 seconds.
[*]Sparks: Balls get electrified, dealing 10x critical damage for 30 seconds.
[*]Multiball:  Classic, fun multiball.
[*]A whole new tutorial/FTUE to match the new style and specials.
[*]Balance pass: All Glyphs (formerly SODA cans), Bumpers, Blockers, and Ball types have been reworked.
[*]Considerable performance improvements.
[*]Better Controller and Steam Deck compatibility.
[/list]
[h2]Heads Up & What's Next[/h2]
This is the first build after a lot of changes, so there are still a fair few bugs kicking about. Hopefully nothing major though, and I'll be trying to update the demo much more frequently now that this big milestone is out of the way so I'll get to squashing those at a much faster rate now.

No new trailer yet.  I'm still working on the table art for the other three tables, and I don't fancy spending a load of time on a trailer that only shows one, then having to redo it again a couple of weeks later. I'll get a new one up ASAP though.

[h2]Apologies & Release Window[/h2]
Anyway, apologies for the long gap between builds, but hopefully, that shouldn't be the case going forward. As for the full game release, I'm aiming for August/September, but keep an eye on this space (*cough* wishlist & follow) for more details.

Happy Flipping! 

Kenny

notes.title: Next Fest Thanks & A Brand New Style!
notes.notes:
First of all, I'd like to say a HUGE thank you to everyone who had a play of PiN during Steam Next Fest, and an even bigger one to those who left feedback and bug reports, it's been a huge motivation to hear people like the game and many of the suggestions have been really inspirational so once again - thank you!

Over and above the feature requests and balancing suggestions, the topic of feedback that really resonalted with me was the games style, or lack thereof - it really was kind of placeholder art that I just never got the time to work on, so I've spent the last few weeks overhauling the entire look and feel of the game to give it the personality and style I always had envisioned for it - a kind of wierd, abstract take on the usual pinball look, whilst still trying to retain visual clarity and keeping the HUD as uncluttered as possible. The result is what you can see now in the screenshots and trailer - there's still a long way to go but I think I can push this style even further so I'm excited to see what else I can do with it! I've taken down the demo while I polish up the last remaining parts of the old style, but will have it back up in a few days. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145033/9e8c1ba2b16ffa8f6a661451f5b63590f70d799d.gif[/img]

The next demo update will also have a bunch of new features - ramp damage has been replaced with an aerial attack that takes multiple missions to trigger but does a huge amount of damage, alongside other special attacks that can now be triggered by completing missions in order, always giving you something to aim towards. Power ups (now called glyphs) can be tailored to each of the special attacks so you can really ramp up the damage (bad pun intended) with your preferred attack and watch the numbers go exponentially higher than before. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145033/dfec787db25e49fac42111d528b9be9ddf6f3373.gif[/img]

I'll post again once the updated demo is live but in the meantime, thanks again for playing and please, please help spread the word, PiN will be coming out sometime in Summer with a firm release date to be announced shortly!

Happy flipping!

Kenny

notes.title: Pin Demo v0.7.1 Patch Notes

Another small patch this week with some QoL upgrades, balance changes and bug fixes!

[u]v0.7.1 [/u]

[u]Features and Balance changes[/u]

- Duplicate Table Traits no longer appear in the same run
- Added a cycling 'To-Do' list on main menu to show all remaining achievements 
- Pryo and Watermelon Balls changed to boost damage and $ when hitting an active Bumper
- Blocker HP now scales off of your current Damage
- The Shop will always offer a Base Blocker perk if you don't currently have one active

- Chances of all blocking effects from Table Traits reduced to 1 in 3 (was 1 in 2)
- $ Rewards for completing a stage reduced

[u]Bug Fixes[/u]

- Fixed a bug where the Bonus Block trait had a 100% chance of blocking Bonus item effects
- Fixed a number of perks that either displayed incorrectly or whose functionality wasn't working as intended
- Fixed issues with Damage per Score perks not being correctly calculated
- Fixed a  number of issues with the Achivement Unlocked panel when returning from a run
- Fixed a number of scenarios where the Slow-Mo effect wasn't triggering when it was meant to

Happy flipping!

Kenny

notes.title: PiN Steam Page is live!
notes.notes:
Announcement time!

[i]PiN [/i]is a Roguelike Pinball Deck-builder, that takes a more casual approach to traditional Pinball games while still retaining a number of their most important elements at it's core - good timing and fast reflexes, alongside missions and ramps and all the other juicy things that make Pinball so satisfying to play. 

Deal damage to the bumpers by hitting them, and try to destroy them all to move onto the next stage. Randomly generated bumper Traits make them harder to hit at higher stages, and stages can also have random Table Traits such as inverted flippers, nudge blocking and other rules that force you to strategically plan ahead if you want to reach and beat Stage 5 to effectively 'beat' the Table (although you can play endlessly after this to try and top the global leaderboard for that table)

The demo is almost ready and I should be able to deploy it on Steam within the next few weeks, although a very rough version of it is already available over on [url=https://kennymakesgames.itch.io/pin]Itch.io[/url]. The demo itself has only one small table that covers the majority of the core mechanics, alongside 5 unlockable balls, 7 difficulty levels and 30 upgrades, which can be bought in the shop after each stage is complete. 

The full game will have 100+ upgrades, and a number of larger, multi-tiered tables, alongside 5 more balls and some new mechanics for dealing damage. 

At this stage, nothing is more valuable than spreading the word so please hit those Wishlist and Follow buttons and stay up to date for when the Demo is live!

Cheers!

Kenny
